Adjust string aesthetics

Source: R/FUNCTIONS_STRINGS.R
string_aes.Rd

Treats spesific characters such as ".", as separating characters and separates strings with space. Trims leading and trailing spaces and capitalizes the first letter of the string and lowers the rest.

Usage

string_aes(
  vector,
  characterlist = c(".", "_", "-", ",", "$", "<p>", "</p>", "<br>", "<br/>", "<B>",
    "</B>", "<BR/>", "|", "/", "&nbsp"),
  proper = TRUE
)

Arguments

vector

Vector

characterlist

List the list of characters to treat as separating characters

proper

Logical TRUE capitalizes the first letter in sentense format

Examples

vector<-c("TES.T","TES<p>T","TES&nbspT")
string_aes(vector=vector)
#> [1] "Tes t" "Tes t" "Tes t"
string_aes(vector=vector,proper=FALSE)
#> [1] "TES T" "TES T" "TES T"
string_aes(vector=vector,proper=TRUE)
#> [1] "Tes t" "Tes t" "Tes t"
